content: Standard high-motion stack: Lenis + GSAP ScrollTrigger on one RAF loop (Lenis autoRaf:false, gsap.ticker drives lenis.raf). Skip scrollerProxy for normal Lenis. Gate with gsap.matchMedia and prefers-reduced-motion. Disable CSS scroll-behavior:smooth when using Lenis. Lenis 1.3.x respects reduced motion options.
